artifacts.title: Phelps v. Pacific Presbytery

matches.evidence: …because PP declined to accept Irons as a candidate for the gospel ministry (per BCO 18-3), Irons was disqualified for the Office of Ruling Elder at NLB. This contention is incorrect. PP was not required to find Irons unqualified…

The central issue of this Case is whether PP erred when it took no action opposing the ordination of Irons to the Office of Ruling Elder by the NLB Session. The Complainant contends that because PP declined to accept Irons as a candidate for the gospel ministr

artifacts.synopsis: Complainant alleged that Pacific Presbytery erred in not opposing the ordination of Lee Irons as a Ruling Elder at New Life Burbank, given that Pacific Presbytery had previously denied Irons's application as a Teaching Elder candidate; the SJC denied the complaint, holding that each court retains discretion to evaluate candidates for ordination within its jurisdiction and that Presbytery's denial for Teaching Elder did not preclude a Session's ordination of the same man as Ruling Elder.
